title: Unauthorized UPI Debit & Arbitrary Bank Rejection

key_legal_principles: Zero customer liability when reported within 3 days
Burden of proof lies on the bank under paragraph 12
Escalation to Banking Ombudsman for compensation

title: SIM Swap Leading to Total Account Siphoning

expected_statutes: State Bank of India vs. P.V. George
key_legal_principles: Third party breach without customer fault
Bank fiduciary duty to prove customer negligence
